blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. x times the quantity x plus five.
The number outside can be a variable too. x multiplies both terms: x times x, plus x times five.
x times x is x squared. x times five is five x, with the number written first.
So the answer is x squared plus five x.
Watch out for these traps. If you multiply only the first term, you get x squared plus five. If you write x times x as two x, you get two x plus five x.
